mechanism: Triamcinolone (corticosteroid) may increase albendazole metabolism via CYP3A4 induction, reducing albendazole bioavailability and efficacy; additionally, corticosteroids can suppress immune response needed for anthelmintic action.
action: Monitor albendazole efficacy closely; consider increasing albendazole dose or using alternative anthelmintic if corticosteroid therapy is necessary; coordinate with prescriber if both agents are essential.
